---

## State of the work

**Role and task.** I am `reviewer`, the pull-request quality gate, on **PR #412** (`コメント統合 A〜D の実装（issue #410）`, base `main`, head `atomaton/issue-410`, open, opened by `engineer` — its body ends with an `Opened by [engineer]` run link). Parent issue **#410** (`システムが投稿するコメントが多すぎる`), whose owner is **yuma-seno**. Issue #410 stays open; no version bump, no release. Constraint from the issue: **no behaviour degradation, ever**.

**What the PR does** (human decision yuma-seno, 2026-10-29: implement A–D in one PR, one commit per measure; E = footer `<details>` fold and F = minimize are *out of scope*):
- **A** `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.ts` — claim the turn in place by appending a `atomaton:took` line to the dispatch marker (marker id IS the ask) instead of posting a second comment; human asks keep the old separate-claim path.
- **B** `src/adapters/actions/dispatch-targets.ts` + `src/adapters/actions/dispatch.ts` — the merge/reject restart directive carries `DISPATCH_TAG` and its id travels as `markerCommentId`, so no second marker is posted (new `RunnerDispatch.markerCommentId`, `refuseOutstandingRequest(d, markerId, ownMarker)`).
- **C** `src/app/aggregation.ts` + `src/adapters/github/sub-issue-report.ts` — the "N sub-task(s) still in progress" line is PATCHed into the child's report (`mergeProgressIntoReport` / `findSubIssueReport` / `withProgressLine`), POST fallback unchanged; `progressMessage` fn replaced by `progress: boolean`.
- **D** `src/entrypoints/machinery/post_result_comment.ts` + `src/workflows/atomaton-runner.wac.ts` + `notify_limit_reached.ts` — the tool tally moves to the result comment footer (`spentOn`), `notified=true|false` is written to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`, and the limit-notice step is gated on `steps.post-result.outputs.notified != 'true'`.

**Rounds so far: 1 previous review round** (`get_pr_reviews` = 0 submitted reviews; PR comment thread = the single claim comment). Round 1 was mine: I returned **two findings** with `/engineer`. Engineer accepted both as real and pushed **`e68373b`** ("Leave a re-run's earlier claim standing, and drop the notice's tally"), parent `eef16a1`.

**Round-1 findings (both agreed real, both claimed fixed):**
1. **A regression** — old `claim_turn.ts:227-232` deleted the took line when its `run` equalled this run's id, reasoning "my own earlier attempt". But a GitHub *Re-run all jobs* keeps `github.run_id` (new attempt of the same run; confirmed via `gh run rerun RUN_ID`, REST `runs/{run_id}/rerun`, UI "previous run attempt"). That would delete the dead attempt's claim — the only record `reconcile_run_ending.ts:237` (`turnClaimedBy`) heals, and what `src/domain/work/thread.ts:507` makes `holder = agent`. The old separate-claim path only deleted the comment *it had just posted*. Required: leave the marker alone, `record(false)`. Also its doc block (`claim_turn.ts:36-54`) described the opposite of what the old code did.
2. **D self-contradiction** — `notify_limit_reached.ts:97-98` said the tally lives on the result-comment footer "now, so it is not repeated here", while `:91` computed `toolCallTally` and `:104` appended it; the PR body said the notice carries no tally, the D commit message said it is "the one carrier". Required either (a) drop the tally (matches the human decision and the PR body) or (b) fix the record to match.

**Verified this round so far:** `get_check_runs` on `atomaton/issue-410` → all required checks **success** (`atomaton-check`, `pull-request-checks (verify)`, `plan-*`, `atomaton-tools`; `default-branch-checks` skipped). `fetch` of `commits/e68373b` shows it touches `claim_turn.test.ts` (adds the re-run test: `claimed=false`, zero PATCH) and `claim_turn.ts` (doc rewrite + removal of `withoutClaimLine` and the same-run-id removal branch). **The API response truncated at 8,000 chars**, so the `notify_limit_reached.ts`, `atomaton-runner.wac.ts` and `notify_limit_reached.test.ts` halves of `e68373b` are still **not directly read** — only the engineer's report of them.

**Verify already established in round 1 and not to be redone:**
- A/B readers: `src/domain/work/thread.ts:391-413` (`askSuperseded`, `run-coming` via `claimedAsks`), `:467-510` (`shapedThread` claim `else if`), `:622-639` (`latestAsk` steps over markers), `:655-657` (`wasLaunched`); `dispatch.ts:679-683` (provided marker used as marker *and* ask), `dispatch.ts:468-525` (no re-POST for caller-supplied markers; refusal deletes it); `dispatch_post_merge.test.ts:96-106` pins the two roles through real readers; `dispatch_post_merge.test.ts:79-85` pins exactly one POST.
- `claimOnMarkerBody` leaves `llm-context` untouched (`claim_turn.test.ts:127-140`).
- C: header has one definition (`sub-issue-report.ts:122-126`), prefix match avoids the bare `atomaton:sub-result` comment / other children / a quoted heading; idempotent replace; POST fallback on read/PATCH failure (`sub-issue-report.ts:191-219`, `aggregation.ts:258-275`); tests at `sub-issue-report.test.ts:227-380` and `aggregate_sub_issues.test.ts:78-148` (1 PATCH, 0 POST).
- `SUB_RESULT_TAG` has **no readers** in `src` (write only at `aggregation.ts:270`).
- D: `post_result_comment.ts:1033-1037,1059-1060`; `src/domain/work/completion-mention.ts:104-112`; workflow gate `atomaton-runner.wac.ts:2360`; `manage_dispatch_loop.ts` untouched and counts `isResultComment` bodies, which this result comment still is — the chain tally is unaffected.
- Deletions checked: `progressMessage` has no remaining references; `dispatch-targets.ts` no longer uses `gh`; no `agent-definitions`/`tools.servers` change; `.github/workflows/` is generated from `src/workflows/` (`atomaton-self-deploy.yml:1-8`) and is **not** committed here; `dist/**` is gitignored.

**Cannot establish (carry into the report):** no shell in this run — tests were not run by me (the green checks are GitHub's evidence, not my measurement); real-GitHub PATCH behaviour (A's append, C's append) and D's real `notified`/skip behaviour are **unmeasured**; the primary-docs line proving `GITHUB_RUN_ID` is invariant across re-runs was not obtainable (docs variables page truncated).

**Known, non-blocking, do not re-raise as a defect:** the **PR body is now inaccurate** (A section still describes a "restore PATCH"/`withoutClaimLine`; the engineer has no tool to edit PR bodies — corrected in commit message `e68373b`). Mention as one tangent line at most. Engineer also declared the accepted cost of (a): on the failure path where no result comment is posted, the tally no longer reaches the thread; the retry sentence does, which satisfies decision condition 5.

**Next actions, in order:**
1. Read the remaining files of `e68373b` (`src/entrypoints/machinery/notify_limit_reached.ts`, `src/workflows/atomaton-runner.wac.ts:2368-2373`, `src/entrypoints/machinery/notify_limit_reached.test.ts:52`) — via `get_pr_diff(pull_number=412)` or a raw fetch at ref `e68373b` — and confirm: marker-with-existing-claim returns `record(false)` with no PATCH; notice body is tag + one sentence with no `Spent on`, `--session`/`readSession`/`toolCallTally` gone; workflow no longer passes `session`.
2. If clean: call `check_merge_readiness(pull_number=412)` **once**, then `merge_pr` if ready; if blockers, act by the table (`merge-policy`/`human-authored`/`merge-gate`/`governance-change` → say it is ready for a person and do not retry; `merge-policy` etc. never edited). If a new blocking defect appears, write `/engineer` and list only evidenced defects.
3. Report in **Japanese** (the thread's language): conclusion first, "how you know" (≤5 anchored `path:line` items), "what you could not establish", "what happens next". No directive line when merging; the machinery then tells @yuma-seno.

レビューの2点を `e68373b` で修正し、`atomaton/issue-410` に push しました（PR #412 は open のまま）。A は「同じ run id の claim を消す」分岐を撤去して触らないだけにし、D は notice から tally を外して記録と実装を一致させています。

**何を確認したか**

<details><summary>根拠（コードと検証結果）</summary>

- A: `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.ts:214-227` — 既存 claim がある分岐は `record(false)` だけになり、PATCH も `withoutClaimLine` も消えました（同関数はこの分岐専用だったので削除）。doc の「自分の先行 attempt を取り消す」記述も、旧コードの実際（**今投稿した自分のコメント**を DELETE し、より古い claim は残す）に合わせて書き換えました。
- A: `src/entrypoints/machinery/claim_turn.test.ts:209` — 再実行ケースのテストを新設（`claimed=false` かつ `PATCH` 0 回）。「同じ run id の claim は先行 attempt のもので、消さない」を固定。
- D: `src/entrypoints/machinery/notify_limit_reached.ts:23-27` で「tally はここには無い（`post_result_comment.ts` が一度だけ計算し、footer に書く）」と明記し、`:97` の body はタグ＋1文だけになりました。`--session` 引数と `readSession`、`toolCallTally` の import は削除。
- D: `src/workflows/atomaton-runner.wac.ts:2368-2373` — notice ステップから `session:` の受け渡しが消え、`bun run synth` 後の `dist/.github/workflows/atomaton-runner.yml:1202` は `--ended-because` までで、`if:` は `... && steps.post-result.outputs.notified != 'true'` のまま。
- D: `src/entrypoints/machinery/notify_limit_reached.test.ts:52` — notice の body が「タグ＋1文」であること、`Spent on` を含まないことを pin（再び tally を足すとテストが落ちる）。
- 検証: `bun run typecheck` clean、`bun test` = 2184 pass / 6 skip / 0 fail（175 files）、`bun run test:e2e` = 5 pass / 6 skip、`bun run synth` 成功（`dist/**` は gitignore のため未コミット）。

</details>

**残るリスク / 確かめられなかったこと**

- **D の代償を明示します**: tally を notice から外したため、終了コメント自体が出ない失敗経路では tally はもうスレッドに出ません（決定「tally を `post_result_comment` 側へ移設」に従った結果）。代役は「ran out of time / got stuck repeating itself … `/agent` で retry」という**行動できる1文**を保つので、条件5（limit の情報が失われない）は満たしますが、tally の有無は情報として減ります。notice に残す案（b）も検討しましたが、同じ session から同じ tally を2スクリプトが計算する重複を作るため採りませんでした。
- **PR 本文は修正できません**: この run に PR 本文の編集手段がなく（`create_pr` のみ）、本文の A 節は「復元 PATCH（`withoutClaimLine`）」、D 節は「tally は持たない」と書いたままです。前者は今や不正確（復元 PATCH は無くなり、`withoutClaimLine` は削除）。正しい記述はコミットメッセージ `e68373b` にあります。
- 実 GitHub への PATCH（A の claim 追記、C の進捗追記）と、実 run での `notified` 出力・notice の skip/実行は依然**未実測**（fake gh・workflow 合成・単体テストのみ）。

**次**

同じ PR で再レビューをお願いします。見てほしいのは、`claim_turn.ts:214-227` の分岐撤去が再実行の claim を残せていること（新テスト `claim_turn.test.ts:209`）と、`notify_limit_reached.ts` の body がタグ＋1文だけになったこと（`notify_limit_reached.test.ts:52`）の2点です。

/reviewer
